# AlphaEvolve: How our Gemini-powered coding agent is scaling impact across fields

Published: 2026-05-07

Canonical link: <https://deepmind.google/blog/alphaevolve-impact/>

Author: AlphaEvolve team

A year ago, we introduced [AlphaEvolve](https://deepmind.google/blog/alphaevolve/), a Gemini-powered coding agent for designing advanced algorithms.

Today, AlphaEvolve is scaling impact across business, infrastructure, and science by automatically discovering and improving high-value algorithms.

## Driving social impact and sustainability

In genomics, AlphaEvolve was used to improve DeepConsensus, achieving a 30% reduction in variant detection errors and helping scientists analyze genetic data more accurately at lower cost.

In grid optimization, AlphaEvolve helped increase the ability of a Graph Neural Network model to find feasible solutions from 14% to over 88%.

## Advancing the frontiers of research

AlphaEvolve is serving as a powerful research partner, accelerating discovery across quantum physics, mathematics, and materials science.

## Improving AI infrastructure

AlphaEvolve has graduated from pilot testing to becoming a core component of our infrastructure optimization toolkit.

Its infrastructure improvements help optimize scheduling, memory usage, and large-scale compute efficiency for AI workloads.

## Scaling commercial applications

Beyond research and infrastructure, AlphaEvolve is helping teams discover practical algorithms that improve product quality and reliability.
